points.quote: `common/`, `browser/` and `electron-browser/` hold the minimal workbench core.
`api/` holds the extension host and the implementation behind `vscode.d.ts`.
`services/` holds core service implementations that aren't specific to one feature.
`contrib/` holds the feature contributions. There are more than 100 of them
Nothing outside `contrib/` may depend on anything inside `contrib/`.
Each contribution has a single `.contribution.ts` entry point.
A contribution exposes its internal API from a single `common` file.
Other contributions that depend on it must use that common API and never reach into its internals.
